install.patchs_readme:
# About the patchs directory

- `system/<patch set>/`: generated automatically, mirroring the patches embedded in the exe grouped by package version (e.g. `legacy/`, `v0.7/`). Rebuilt on every install — do not modify; only the set matching the package version is applied during install.
- `custom/`: put custom patches here, named `modify_unity_local_1.patch`, `modify_unity_local_2.patch`, … They are applied in ascending numeric order after the built-in patches; .patch files with other names are skipped.
